_how_to_edit: Change name or lines here, then run: python design/scratch-cards/build_positions.py. Max about 48 characters per line, two lines. The drawings live in build_positions.py under the same id.

positions.name: Spooning
lines: Both on one side, one curled behind the other.

positions.name: From Behind
lines: One on hands and knees, the other kneels behind.
Hands on hips, take your time.

positions.name: Missionary
lines: One lies back, the other lies over.

positions.name: Lotus
lines: Sitting up, one in the other's lap.

positions.name: Standing
lines: Face to face, one leg lifted and held.
